act.name: Karnataka Rent Act, 1999
act.description: State Act regulating rent and eviction of tenants in urban areas of Karnataka (Bengaluru, Mysuru, Mangaluru, etc.).

sections.title: Protection of tenant against eviction in Karnataka
sections.chapter: Chapter V - Control of Eviction of Tenants
sections.text: (1) Protection of tenant against eviction.— No order or decree for the recovery of possession of any premises shall be made by any court or Rent Controller in favour of the landlord against a tenant except on an application made to the Court on specific statutory grounds.
sections.plain_language_summary: In Karnataka (Bengaluru), landlords must follow Rent Court procedures and cannot forcefully evict tenants or withhold deposit unlawfully.
